witness.description: Fragment certificate for L1: the exact-integer verifier recomputes r_A(n) by exhaustive enumeration in exact integer arithmetic for each finitary case, accepts a correct supplied f_A table, rejects a corrupted one, and fails closed (raises) on a missing or negative f_A entry. Witness is embedded; no files, no imports, no I/O.

run.detail: ValueError: case pos_A_finite: expected ACCEPT, verifier produced REJECT

claim: Clean termination (RESULT is True, no exception) establishes: the exact-integer verifier exposes a verify(witness) entrypoint that recomputes r_A(n) for every n<=N by exhaustive enumeration in exact integer arithmetic, is sound and complete for the finitary counting predicate on the supplied instances (accepts a correct f_A table, rejects a corrupted one), and raises — fail closed — on a missing or negative f_A entry (the ABORT cases demonstrate the raise path live). This is the finite, decidable fragment of L1 exactly as stated. The ∀A∀ε eventually-lower-bound and o(√N) clauses of the campaign target are outside this certificate's scope.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
